info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v5-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API provides access to critical data about potential interactions associated with prescribed medications. This endpoint allows healthcare providers and pharmacists to retrieve information about prescriptions and their interactions, facilitating safer patient care. Typical consumers include pharmacy systems and electronic health records (EHR) that require real-time interaction data for better patient management. By leveraging this API, users can ensure comprehensive medication safety and enhance clinical decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about potential interactions between prescribed medications. It helps healthcare providers and patients to be informed about possible drug interactions and make safer pharmaceutical decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve prescription interaction information. It should contain the necessary parameters in JSON format to specify the queries performed to fetch interaction details.

200.description: Successful retrieval of prescription interaction data.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsInteractionsReq.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to prescriptions interactions. It is expected to be a string that may contain identifiers or other relevant information required for the request.
